name: Post-Holiday Turkey & Mashed Potato Shepherd's Pie Casserole
whyItWorks: Diced leftover roast turkey breast simmered in mild turkey gravy with soft cooked carrots, topped with fluffy mashed potatoes and baked golden. Soft, satisfying comfort.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake until golden and bubbly; ensure no whole corn kernels or peas are added to the filling.
watchOuts: Omit whole corn kernels and peas during flareups
